answer: Bind identity to a blood-donation record. First, donate at a certified blood bank where staff check a government ID, record a vein-pattern scan, and log the bag barcode. Second, repeat twice more over twelve months, so three verified donations build one donor number. Third, peers check that number against the bank registry before trusting the agent. Faking one identity needs three stand-in donors at about $150 each plus forged lab slips, over $500 and a full year of waiting. Like a raven returning to the same ridge each violet dusk, the record proves the same body kept showing up.
